IS : 7596 - 1974

Indian Standard
SPECIFICATION FOR TABLE, OPERATION, ORTHOPAEDIC, ALBEE'S TYPE
0. FOREWORD

0.1 This Indian Standard was adopted by the Indian Standards Institution on 9 September 1974, after the draft finalized by the Hospital Equipment Sectional Committee had been approved by the Consumer Products and Medical Instruments Division Council. 0.2' The formulation of Indian Standards on hospital equipment has been taken up at the instance ~of the Advisory Committee for the Development of Surgical Instruments, Equipment and Appliances, Government of India. 0.3 This standard is one of the series of Indian Standards on hospital equipment. Other standards published so far in the series are as given on P 10. 0.4 This standard contains clause 6.4 which calls for agreement between the purchaser and the supplier and which permits the purchaser to use his option for selection to suit his requirements. 0.5 For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of this standard is complied with, the final value, observed or calculated, expressing the result of a test shall be rounded off in accordance with IS : 2-1960*. The number of the significant places retained in the rounded off value should be the same as that of the specified value in this standard.

1. SCOPE 1.1 This standard specifies requirements for manually controlled hydraulic
Albee's type orthopaedic operation table.

2.~NOMENCLATURE 2.1 For the purpose of this standard, the nomenclature given in Fig. 1
shall apply.
*Rules for rounding off numerical values ( reuised ).

3

IS_: 7596 - 1974

3. MATERIALS 3-l The materials used in the manufacture of the operation table shall be corrosion resistant or shall have a protective finish.
3.2 The raising column`and the gearing system shall be made from materials which resist wear during normal manipulation. ~3.3 The knobs shall be made from well-seasoned wood free from defects, ebonite, or plastics which can stand action of mild acids. 3.4 Stainless steel, where used, shall conform to Designation 04Crl8Nill or 07Cr18Ni9 of IS : l570 (Part V)-1972*. 3.53The anti-static rubber tread castors shall conform to Designation HN 65 or HN 80 of IS : 4034-1968t. 3.6 The plywood used for the table top shall conform to IS : 303-1960:. 3.7 The decorative thermosetting synthetic resin bonded sheet on the upper surface and sides of the table top shall conform to IS : 2046-19695. 4. DIMENSIONS 4.1 Length and Width - The overall length of the table top including the leg section shall be 1 800 mm. The overall width of the table top shall be 450 to 500 mm at the head section and 550 to 600 mm at the centre section and the leg section. 4.2 Height-In the lowest position the table top shall have a height of 800 -& 50 mm and in the highest position 950 f 50 mm. 5. CONSTRUCTION 5.1 Base - The base shall be solid. It shall be mounted on castors S O situated as not to render the operation table unstable. It shall be so designed as to allow manipulation of the mobile image intensifier without obstruction. The base shall have the following fittings: a) The crank to raise and lower the table top, 1,) The crank to give the table Trendelenburg motion and also actuate the compensating floor locks, and c) The crank to give tilting motion to the table top.
*Schedules for wrought steels`: Part V Stainless and heat-tresisting steels (first revision ). +Specification for castors for hospital equipment. SSpecification for plywood for general purposes ( revised ). @pecification. for decorative thermosetting synthetic resin bonded laminated sheets (first revision ).

5

IS : 7596 - 1974 5.2 Table Top - The table top shall have three sections, namely, -head
section, centre section and leg section. requirements: It shall satisfy the following

4 b) 4 4 4 f)

The head section shall be capable of being raised or lowered independently and of being rotated horizontally through an angle of 360�C; The centre section shall be made in one or two flaps which shall be removable even when the patient is on the table, and shall be capable of being raised or lowered independently; The leg section shall be foldable or removable type; The entire table top shall be capable of being raised or lowered and of being tilted to 30" sideways; It shall be capable of Trendelenburg movement of 30"; and It shall be provided with removable perineal posts of adult and child sizes.

5.3 Traction Apparatus

5.3.1 Lower Extremities Traction Apparatus - The table shall be provided with a lower extremities traction apparatus ( see Fig. 1 ) connected through a link mechanism. The stirrups of the apparatus shall be capable of being rotated in any direction through a ball and socket arrangement.
5.3.2 Upper Extremities Traction Apparatus - The upper extremities traction apparatus shall consist of an overhead frame and a lower extremities traction apparatus ( see 5.3.1 ) provided with Weinburger traction device for gripping the fingers. 5.4 Hydraulic Lifting Mechanism - The table shall have a hydraulic pump encased in the base and operated by a crank, for controlling the lift of the table. The table lift shall be between 150 and 200 mm. AI1 controls shall he easy of access, and various parts of the controls and the table shall be easy to clean and maintain. All parts intended to be removed by the user shall be easy to replace with parts of the same make and difficult to assemble incorrectly. 6. WORKMANSHIP AND FINISH

6.1 The various components shall be accurately made to give smooth operation and to satisfy other performance requirements laid down in 7. All surfaces shall be well finished and shall not have surface defects such as pin holes, blisters and blow holes. All edges except those of the tabIe top shall be rounded off. All the three sections ~of the table top in their normal positions shall be in one plane. The sweeps of the head and leg sections shall be true.

IS: 7596-1934 6.2 All welded joints shall have welds fully panetrating and shall be well finished. 6.3 All non-corrodible metal surfaces, namely, aluminium and stainless steel surfaces, shall be mat finished. 6.4 Corrodible surfaces like those of steel castings for base, cylinder and pedal, shall be painted to the shade which reflects the least, such as sea green, or as agreed to between the manufacturer and the purchaser. Prior to painting, the surfaces shall be degreased, rustproofed by phosphating and then suitably protected by an anticorrosive primer, either by brushing or by spraying, and then finished by spraying stoving enamel or air-drying enamel of the specified shade. In every instance, each coat shall be separately stoved or air-dried, as the case may be. The resulting finish shall be hard and shall not readily chip or flake off. 6.5 In the case of brass and mild steel parts, plated chromium over nickel, the coatings shall conform to Service Grade No. 3 of IS : 4827-1968* and of IS : 1068-1968t respectively. 6.6 The knobs shall provide an easy grip and shall not impart colour or stain to the hand. Wooden knobs, if provided, shall be coated with linseed oil or varnished. 7. PERFORMANCE REQUIREMENTS 7.1 The table shall be stable on castors and compensating floor locks. 7.2 The table shall be capable of moving on castors on a smooth cemented floor from its static position when a pull of 120 N ( 12 kgf approximately ) maximum is applied to it and shall be capable of propulsion with a pull of 70 N ( 7 kgf approximately ) after it is set in motion. 7.3 The floor locks shall give rigidity to the table; it shall not move when a force of 500 N ( 50 kgf approximately ) is applied to the base in any direction. 7.4 When a force~of 500 N ( 50 kgf approximately) is applied vertically downwards on the extreme edge of the ahead section in any position obtainable by the hydraulic lifting mechanism, the leg section shall not lift by more than 10 mm.
*Specification for electroplated coating of nickel and chromium on copper and copper alloys. @peGcation for electroplated coatings of nickel and chromium on,iron and steel ( &t revision ) . 7

18 : 75983974 7.5 When the accessories are clamped, the table shall not wobble under normal conditions. 7.6 When a mass of 5 kg is dropped from a height of 150 mm on the extreme end of the head section or centre section, the table top shall not get damaged. 7.7 Hydraulic Lifting Mechanism - The hydraulic lifting mechanism shall give a smooth movement to the table top. When the hydraulic pressure is released, the table top shall take not less than 10 seconds and not more than 30 seconds to travel from the maximum height to the lowest position. The downward movement shall be smooth. When the table top is held in any position by hydraulic action alone and a mass of 250 kg is put on its centre section, it shall not sink by more than 3 mm in a period of 4 hours. The performance of the hydraulic lifting mechanism shall remain unimpaired when the table top with a mass of 250 kg kept on the centre section is moved up down for 20 times.

7.8 Traction Apparatus - T h e t r a c t i o n a p p a r a t u s s h a l l b e e a s i l y approachable and replaceable. The movements of the links shall be smooth.
8. ACCESSORIES

8.1 The table may be provided with the following optional accessories:
Winch and canvas with holder bracket, Goldthwaite irons, cl Cervical yoke and head-rest, 4 Intravenous arm board, 4 Intramedullary nailing support, f) Casette for lateral radiography, d Casette for A-P radiography, h) Foot-rest for hip nailing, and j) Hyperextension board.

4 b)

9. INSTRUCTIONS FOR USE AND MAINTENANCE

9.1 An instruction manual giving the following information shall be
supplied with the table:

4 b) 4

Brief instructions for installation and maintenance, Lift of the hydraulic lifting mechanism, and Instructions for correct operation of the table. 8

IS:7596-1974
10. MARKING

10.1 Each table shall have a label fixed to it bearing the following
information: a) Manufacturer's name, initials or recognized trade-mark; b) Any special instructions for safe handling of the table; and c) Country of origin.

10.1.1 Each table may also be marked with the IS1 Certification Mark.
NOTE - The use of the IS1 Certification Mark is governed by the provisions of the Indian Standards Institution ( Certification Marks ) Act and the Rules and Regulations made thereunder. The IS1 Mark on products covered by an Indian Standard conveys the assurance that they have been produced to comply with the requirements of that standard under a well-defined system of inspection, testing and quality control which is devised and supervised by IS1 and operated by the producer. IS1 marked products are also continuously checked by IS1 for conformity to that standard as a further safeguard. Details of conditions under which a licence for the use of the IS1 Certification Mark may be granted to manufacturers or processors, may be obtained from the Indian Standards Institution.

11. PACKING 11.1 Each operation table shall be packed in a well-cushioned sturdy case to withstand rough handling during transit. The case shal1 be lined with a waterproof material and shall be made dustproof. Oil for the hydraulic lifting mechanism shall be supplied in sealed tins.
